newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse index eases in downward market.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse index eases in downward market.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index Semdex eased 2.03 points to 377.19 on Friday reflecting a market that was mostly moving downwards.
Brokers said turnover was posted at 7.45 million rupees on 297,615 shares from 10.67 million rupees on 480,202 shares.
"A share price fall among banks stocks has brought down the Semdex," brokers said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank lost a rupee to 86 rupees on 27,718 shares and State Bank of Mauritius fell 20 cents to 11.40 rupees on 103,622 shares.

One broker said market liquidity had dried off as there were many sellers but no buyers on the stock market. He added that the absence of buyers on the market meant the absence of buying interest mainly from foreign investors.
In the tourism sector, New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 37 on 50,565 shares, Sun Resorts climbed 10 cents to 48.60 on 510 shares and Grand Baie Hotel was unchanged at 47.20.

Commerce-based conglomerate Rogers was a rupee lower at 97 on 300 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd eased 30 cents to 15.60 on 5,839 shares. Shell fell 10 cents to 21.60 on 3,703 shares and Happy World Foods remained at 15.50 rupees on 2,094 shares.
Industry stocks Mauritius Breweries Ltd was stable at 145 rupees on 2,282 shares and Mauritius Oil Refineries (MOR) was unchanged to 11.40 rupees on 50,000 shares.
In the sugar sector, Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) lost 10 cents to 39.10 rupees on 887 shares, whereas the other listed sugar stocks were stable, but unquoted.
Air Mauritius was unchanged at 39 on 980 shares.
